title: I Investigated Sadhguru's Moon Science and Here's What I Found
tags: what happens to you on a full moon day?
description:
For centuries, the moon has been blamed for everything from crime waves and suicides to fertility, menstrual cycles, earthquakes, and even werewolves. Spiritual gurus and WhatsApp University “graduates” still push these myths, while media and movies amplify the nonsense. But what does science actually say?

In this documentary, Pale Blue Thoughts busts the most popular lunar myths:

Does the full moon cause madness?

Are birth rates and fertility linked to moon phases?

Do accidents and disasters happen more during full moons?

Does the moon’s gravity affect the water inside our bodies?

Can the moon trigger earthquakes?

Lunar Myths Busted

We dive into studies by Ivan Kelly, James Rotton, Roger Culver, Kelly & Martens (1994), and Martens et al. (1988) — all showing no significant correlation between the full moon and human behavior, births, or disasters. The gravitational pull of a mother holding her baby is 12 million times stronger than the moon’s pull on the same baby! And the idea that the Earth is 70% water so the moon must affect us? Completely wrong — the surface of Earth is 70% water, and the moon mainly affects large open bodies of water, not the water locked in our cells.

The lunar effect book by Arnold Lieber, which predicted a catastrophic earthquake in California in 1982, turned out to be pseudoscience. Just like the myth linking the full moon with suicide — multiple studies (including 897 cases in Madrid) found no such correlation. What really keeps these myths alive is media hype, selective memory, and confirmation bias.

If you’ve searched for full moon myths debunked, lunar myths explained, moon and madness, does the moon affect fertility, or earthquake lunar myths, this video sets the record straight.
